description: Load the committed ACE Fe3O4 bulk trajectory through the post shell and check the documented population, box and spin-population facts. Composition convention: types 1 and 2 are both Fe (type 2 is the ACE Mn proxy slot for Fe_down), so metal:O = 192:256 = 3:4 and type1:type2 = 64:128 = 1:2.
source: Fixture facts aggregated from the committed data file without repository code (awk over the element column and TIMESTEP/BOX BOUNDS headers of tests/fixtures/ace_examples/regular_MD/traj.dump, 2026-10-31): 350 frames, 448 atoms, Fe 64 / Mn 128 / O 256 in every frame, first TIMESTEP 100, last 3587, frame-0 bounds 0..16.79 A, BOX BOUNDS pp pp pp. Consistent with .cursor/rules/tests-and-goldens.mdc. Type numbering (Fe->1, Mn->2, O->3) and the spin reading (1 = Fe_up, 2 = Fe_down in the Mn proxy slot) follow lammpkeeper/common/mapping.py and the analyze_spin_evolution docstring; README.md cites Bienvenu et al., npj Comput. Mater. 11, 81, 2025 for the convention. box_lengths refers to frame 0 only: the NPT trajectory box varies between 16.737 and 17.182 A in later frames.

sources.metal_to_o_ratio: (64 + 128) / 256 from the awk counts; magnetite A+B : O = 3 : 4
sources.type1_to_type2_ratio: 64 / 128 from the awk counts; in this fixture type 1 occupies the tetrahedral sites (4 O at 1.883 A in the relaxed tail), but the site assignment is fixture-specific and is documented, not checked
